description: This file is a CMake module script that attempts to locate the LIBOPKG library and its headers on the system. It defines variables indicating whether the library was found, and where its include directories and libraries are located.
external_files: libopkg headers such as opkg.h, opkg_cmd.h, opkg_download.h

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Searches for a package configuration, in this case, PkgConfig.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Attempts to locate the LIBOPKG library in the system libraries.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for specific header files of LIBOPKG within potential include directories.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks certain variables as advanced, hiding them in GUIs or advanced views.
